title: 30 Days of Content From 1 Idea
caption:
You don't have a content problem. You have a repurposing problem. ♻️

1 idea → 30 days of content:

1️⃣ One long piece: guide, video or thread
2️⃣ Cut it into 6 carousels (one point each)
3️⃣ Turn each carousel into a 30-sec talking clip
4️⃣ Pull 10 quotes for static posts
5️⃣ Reshape it all into 1 email for your list

AI does the cutting. You do the thinking. ⚡

Save this 📌 — your content calendar just got simpler.
